description: Update ordinary study metadata only, such as name, format, language, voice, or incentives. Use customize_study—not this tool—for the research plan, audience targeting, screener questions, concept links, or concept images. Only supplied fields change. Active panel studies must be paused or stopped first. Call get_study first.

auto_send_incentives.description: Send the configured incentive automatically after an eligible interview.

incentive_amount.description: Incentive in US dollars for each eligible BYOP participant.

is_incentives_enabled.description: Enable incentives for eligible BYOP participants.

byop_config.description: Incentive settings for participants you bring to this study.

interview_format.description: Interview mode. Defaults to voice when omitted.

name.description: Short internal label, max 40 characters (e.g. "Frozen pizza switchers US").

organization_id.description: Organization for this operation and billing. Use list_organizations to choose an active membership.

recruiting_method.description: Choose from the brief: panel to recruit real participants, byop to invite the user’s own participants, or synthetic_respondents for simulated participants. Ask only if the recruiting method is unclear.

study_id.description: UUID of the study, as returned by list_studies.

study_type.description: Research design: in-depth interview, concept test, or prototype test.

voice.description: Interviewer configuration for every format, including chat. Defaults to male when omitted.

name: update_study

result.description: The updated study. Call get_study for full state.

title: Update Study
